justifications.functional_suitability: Catalog & Search Service, Order & Checkout Service, and Recommendation & Review Service address R-01 through R-04. Multi-currency and shipping APIs are supported via Third-Party Shipping Providers and Search Index Client. Specific fulfillment mechanisms for electronic books and dedicated GDPR/CCPA data subject rights workflows are not explicitly modeled.
justifications.performance_efficiency: Amazon CloudFront, Redis on Amazon ElastiCache, Search Index Client (Amazon OpenSearch), Amazon RDS Proxy, and Amazon SQS queues effectively decouple workloads and minimize read latencies to meet the 1 M MAU scaling and under 2 s 3G page load targets.
justifications.compatibility: Payment & Tax Integration Component connects smoothly to Payment Gateway, Third-Party Shipping Providers, and Tax & Compliance Service via REST over HTTPS with circuit breakers, ensuring resilient interoperability with external partner APIs.
justifications.usability: Public Catalog SPA and Authenticated Customer Portal SPA provide accessible interfaces for site visitors and buyers. However, internal personas like Content Moderator / Administrator and Catalog / Quality Analyst lack defined frontend interfaces to interact with the moderation and analytics components.
justifications.reliability: Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL Cluster with Multi-AZ, Amazon RDS Proxy, circuit breakers on external HTTP clients, and Notification DLQ support the 99.95% uptime target. However, cross-region replication mechanisms across the required us-east-1, eu-west-1, and ap-southeast-1 regions are omitted.
justifications.security: OWASP mitigations and confidentiality are addressed via Edge Security & Routing Component (AWS WAF), JWT Authorizer / Auth Validator, mTLS via AWS App Mesh, and AWS Secrets Manager with AWS KMS. Explicit privacy controls for GDPR & CCPA data erasure/export are absent.
justifications.maintainability: Microservices are well-modularized with clear internal layers across controllers, managers, and repositories. However, there is ambiguous boundary overlap between Recommendation & Review Service and Customer Review & Moderation Service regarding review handling and persistence.
justifications.portability: The containerized services on AWS ECS on Fargate are well-adapted to the specified AWS environment. Strong architectural dependence on proprietary services like AWS App Mesh, AWS Personalize, and Amazon SQS limits potential migration to other cloud providers.

PERF-01.justification: CloudFront edge caching, Redis ElastiCache catalog caching, OpenSearch search index offloading, and RDS Proxy with Aurora Multi-AZ handle massive traffic spikes with low latency.
elements: Public Catalog & Search SPA & Authenticated Customer Portal SPA
sensitivity_points: Edge caching hit ratios on CloudFront and Redis
OpenSearch query latency under high concurrent load
tradeoffs: Aggressive catalog caching trades real-time stock updates for fast read performance

PERF-02.justification: Recommendation processing is offloaded to external AWS Personalize and cached via Redis, isolating heavy computations from synchronous catalog browsing workflows.
sensitivity_points: Redis cache hit ratio for personalized recommendation endpoints
Network latency connecting to AWS Personalize
tradeoffs: Serving cached recommendations trades absolute personalization freshness for lower browsing latency

AVAIL-01.justification: Payment & Tax Integration uses circuit breakers on third-party shipping APIs, while Order Fulfillment decouples shipping via Amazon SQS for deferred asynchronous processing.
sensitivity_points: Circuit breaker timeout and trip thresholds for shipping APIs
SQS queue durability and retry policies
tradeoffs: Asynchronous fulfillment trades immediate shipping confirmation for uninterrupted checkout availability

AVAIL-02.justification: The architecture only provisions a Multi-AZ Aurora cluster within a single region and lacks multi-region replication, cross-region storage synchronization, and global DNS failover.
elements: Public Catalog & Search SPA & Authenticated Customer Portal SPA
sensitivity_points: Absence of Amazon Route 53 global routing policies
Lack of Aurora Global Database cross-region replication
tradeoffs: Single-region deployment minimizes operational complexity and cross-region costs but risks full outage

MOD-01.justification: Multi-currency support is modularly isolated within Search Index Client, Payment & Tax Integration Component, and delegated to external payment and tax providers.
sensitivity_points: Third-party payment gateway currency conversion support
tradeoffs: Delegating currency conversion to external APIs reduces code changes but increases third-party dependency

MOD-02.justification: The recommendation logic is cleanly abstracted inside Recommendation Logic Controller and delegates to AWS Personalize via REST, isolating all algorithm modifications from other services.
sensitivity_points: Interface consistency between Recommendation Logic Controller and the recommendation engine
tradeoffs: Abstracting recommendations behind a unified controller slightly increases internal request hops

SEC-01.justification: AWS WAF filters malicious payloads at CloudFront, API Gateway validates requests, Spring Data JPA / ORMs prevent SQL injection, and Centralized Logging SIEM tracks security events.
sensitivity_points: AWS WAF managed rule set update cadence
Strict input validation and parametrized database queries
tradeoffs: Extensive edge and gateway payload inspection adds slight latency to incoming requests

SEC-02.justification: Data resides across Aurora, Redis, SQS, and logs. While services have database access, there is no automated orchestration mechanism or workflow component for complete CCPA/GDPR erasure.
sensitivity_points: Lack of a centralized privacy erasure orchestration mechanism
Immutable logs and backups containing customer personal data
tradeoffs: Decentralized service databases complicate data erasure verification across all domain boundaries

elements: Public Catalog & Search SPA & Authenticated Customer Portal SPA
